fix_instructions: The scenario is currently too easy because the model can satisfy the goal using only public facts; however, since all checks failed, the issue is that the model did not even attempt to use the hidden information. To make this a valid multi-agent scenario, ensure that the public facts are intentionally ambiguous or contradictory such that the model *must* access the private facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4) to resolve them. Specifically, tighten C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C9, and C10 so they cannot be satisfied by the default/public values provided in S1, S2, and S3.
